      • getMetaDataNode

        @NotNull
public @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource getMetaDataNode()
        Description copied from interface: Release
        The resource that contains metadata for this release. This is not touched by the StagingReleaseManager and can be freely used to store additional metadata. If you want to change it, just retrieve the Release object and write on the resource returned here - the StagingReleaseManager does not care about its contents.
        Specified by:
        getMetaDataNode in interface Release

      • getChangeNumber

        @NotNull
public @NotNull String getChangeNumber()
        Description copied from interface: Release
        An UID that changes on each release content change. If it's constant, you can rely on the release content being the same. (Unless for changes not using the StagingReleaseManager, which you shouldn't do, of course. At least not without calling #bumpReleaseChangeNumber(Release), too.)
        Specified by:
        getChangeNumber in interface Release

      • absolutePath

        @NotNull
public @NotNull String absolutePath​(@Nullable
                                    @Nullable String path)
        Description copied from interface: Release
        Maps the relative path to the absolute path ( Release.getReleaseRoot() + '/' + relativePath ) ; if it's already an absolute path into the release this returns it unmodified. If it's a path into the interal release store, it's transformed to the absolute path into the content that corresponds to that path. If it does not belong to the release at all, an IllegalArgumentException is thrown. For an empty path, the release root is returned.
        Specified by:
        absolutePath in interface Release

      • unwrap

        public static DefaultStagingReleaseManager.ReleaseImpl unwrap​(@Nullable
                                                              @Nullable Release release)
        This is used to unwrap release to be able to access implementation specific methods, and performs a sanity check that the release is still there - that's also a weak measure to ensure this was created in the DefaultStagingReleaseManager, not outside.

      • mapToContentCopy

        @NotNull
public @NotNull String mapToContentCopy​(@NotNull
                                        @NotNull String path)
        Maps paths pointing into the release content to the release content copy.
        Parameters:
        path - an absolute or relative path
        Returns:
        if path is absolute, return the path in the releases content copy that corresponds to that path - we don't check whether it actually exists. If it is relative, returns the path in the releases content copy that has that path relative to the release.
